# JL Closets

> South Florida's custom closet and storage design-build company, based in Boca Raton, FL. Designs, builds, and installs custom closets, pantries, home offices, garages, mudrooms, laundry rooms, and entertainment centers for homeowners across Palm Beach, Broward, Miami-Dade, Lee, Collier, Martin, St. Lucie, Indian River, and Okeechobee counties.

JL Closets offers free in-home design consultations, custom cabinetry finishes, and full installation. Phone: (561) 912-9881. Address: 160 NW 16th St, Boca Raton, FL 33432.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://jlclosets.com/): overview of services, process, and service areas
- [Custom Closets](https://jlclosets.com/custom-closets): walk-in, reach-in, and shoe storage solutions
- [Walk-In Closets](https://jlclosets.com/custom-closets/walk-in-closets): walk-in closet designs, lighting, doors/drawers, islands, shelving
- [Closet Lighting](https://jlclosets.com/accessories/closet-lighting): countertop, wardrobe, and accent lighting accessories
- [Portfolio](https://jlclosets.com/portfolio): photo gallery of completed custom closet, pantry, garage, and storage projects
- [Showroom](https://jlclosets.com/showroom): visiting the Boca Raton showroom, hours, address, and directions
- [FAQ](https://jlclosets.com/faq): answers to common questions about design, materials, pricing, installation, and warranty
- [About Us](https://jlclosets.com/about): company background and story
- [Contact](https://jlclosets.com/contact): consultation scheduling and contact form
